full_judgment: 14. It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the petitioner that the property has been released as surplus unused land under sections 92 and 93 of Town Improvement Act 1953 by a statutory registered agreement for consideration by RAJUK consequent on the resolution adopted in the meeting of the committee held in the chamber of ADC(Rev.), on 23-4-82 in which it was decided to release the property in favour of Khaleque Munshi and others and the petitioners having purchased the land after taking note that the property has been released by due process of law the petitioners are the bonafide purchaser by registered instrument which carry with it the presumption of valid transfer and can only be nullified by the court of competent jurisdiction. Mr. Nabi cited the case decided in WP No. 1041 of 1992 in February 1995 (Jahanara Rashid vs. Government) The learned Advocate also pleaded the effect of promissory estoppel stating that the Government having released 13 acres of land on 2-4-84 by registered deed No. 3092 in favour of Khaleque Munshi cannot now resale and deny the legality of the transfer.
